articles.summary: Conducting a review of pre-existing literature relies on finding foundational research that is heavily cited across a subfield. While it’s a time-consuming and painstaking process, it’s a must for writing literature reviews, grant proposals, and IP applications.
articles.title: How to Find Seminal Research with Epsilon

articles.summary: Epsilon makes it easier than ever to compare and contrast findings from different scientific articles.
articles.title: Compare and Contrast Insights From Multiple Papers
